root.name: サリー・ビューティー

rows.ja: 主要な仕入先(上位5社で仕入の44%)
rows.en: Top suppliers (five make up 44% of purchases)

relations.text: 上位5社の仕入先の一社(5社で仕入の約44%、2026年9月期)
relations.text_en: One of its five largest suppliers (about 44% of FY2026 purchases)

source.label: Sally Beauty 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: For fiscal year 2026, our five largest suppliers-Henkel AG & Co. KGaA; Wella Company; the Professional Products Division of L'Oreal USA S/D, Inc.; John Paul Mitchell Systems; and Kao Corporation-accounted for approximately 44% of our consolidated merchandise purchases.
